Name: Haley's Children for Immersive Unique Children Talk
Author: xiaoleiwen
Description:
This is just sharing the "own-used" portraits for Haley's children that I have commissioned [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/147754183]GildedRose[/url] that match the sprites from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url] MOD and the expressions used in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17054]Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url] MOD.

How to install:

1) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]Unique Children Talk[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278]Unique Children[/url]﻿.
2) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17054]Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url]﻿ (optional but you may consider this if you want to see the expressions being fully utilized).
3) Place the png file(s) from this MOD to the assets/Portrait folder of the [b]Unique Children Talk[/b] folder, and rename it like your child.

For example:
assets/Portraits/Rayden.png
assets/Portraits/Rorelai.png
